pay_detail: Stipend of up to $1,800 for coursework and internship work. No fee listed.
duration: Summer 2027 plan: June 23 to Aug 27 (15 to 24 hours a week)
name: These Teens Mean Busine$$ Summer Internship
what_you_do: Teens complete 90 to 144 internship hours at 15 to 24 hours a week. They also take job readiness training on June 15 and 17 and weekly coursework, and show their work at a showcase.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 9 to 12 living in the Madison area. Must have finished a CEOs of Tomorrow program, taken a school business course, or be in DECA Business Club.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Summer 2027 hiring day: Saturday, May 22. Job readiness training June 15 and 17.
how_to_apply: Click Apply Today on the internship page. Questions: 608-298-6949 or the Contact Us page.
notes: Participants earn 2 Madison College Prior Learning Credits at no cost and may earn up to 2 MMSD high school credits. Page dates are shown without a year; they match 2027.
